items.headline: Update: US Equity Indexes Rise as Cooling Inflation Eases Interest-Rate Pressure on Tech While IBM Sell-Off Restrains Dow
items.summary: (Updates with index/price moves, macroeconomic data, and geopolitical news from the first paragraph.

items.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq end higher on cool inflation data, solid bank earnings - Reuters
items.summary: S&P 500 and Nasdaq end higher on cool inflation data, solid bank earnings  Reuters

items.headline: IBM stock craters 25%, the worst day on record, after company issues second-quarter earnings warning
items.summary: The CEO blamed the shortfall on weakness in the software and infrastructure business because clients shifted money toward hardware purchases.

items.headline: Cybersecurity stocks rally on AI spending change comments from IBM's Krishna
items.summary: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna told CNBC's Sara Eisen that some major deals were put on hold toward the end of the quarter as businesses rethink spending.

items.headline: U.S. strikes Iran before Hormuz Strait blockade restarts
items.summary: President Donald Trump has said the U.S.-Iran ceasefire is over following multiple flare-ups of hostilities in the region.

items.headline: The AI boom just found two new winners: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase
items.summary: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan showed that Wall Street is a major beneficiary of the AI boom, with record revenue driven by surging trading and investment banking.

items.headline: 3 Reasons Apple Stock Got Downgraded
items.summary: Shares could soon look “too expensive,” KeyBanc’s Brandon Nispel warns as he cuts his rating for the iPhone maker.

items.headline: Jim Cramer says concerns about AI market froth are overblown. Here's why
items.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said today's stock market is far less concerning than it was during the dot-com bubble.

items.headline: Current and former employees sue Meta, alleging discrimination in using AI to conduct layoffs
items.summary: The lawsuit filed by current and former Meta employees underscores rising concerns about AI's impact on jobs and people with disabilities in the workforce.

items.headline: Micron stock jumps as investors look beyond GPUs in AI chip trade
items.summary: KeyBanc’s target raise puts the focus on memory-chip pricing as AI demand lifts DRAM, NAND and HBM.

items.headline: Zipline adds ex-Tesla, Uber, Waymo execs to make drone delivery mainstream across U.S.
items.summary: Zipline is growing its drone delivery business in the U.S., and has hired former Tesla, Uber Eats and Waymo executives to help it scale up in new markets.

items.headline: Here’s the inflation breakdown for June 2026 — in one chart
items.summary: The consumer price index rose 3.5% in June from a year earlier, a deceleration after several months of upward moves.

items.headline: Strong Markets, Growing Complexity
items.summary: In our view, the second quarter was defined by strong but uneven US equity performance. The S&P 500 delivered a solid rebound in April, posting its best monthly gain since November 2020 and moving to fresh record highs before volatility re-emerged in June.

items.headline: Top Stocks For H2 2026!
items.summary: Following the momentum of our annual picks, we're back with the Top Stocks for H2 2026. Watch now to discover high-conviction mid-year stock picks!

items.headline: Jim Cramer Still Can’t Believe NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA)’s Share Price Performance
items.summary: Even though the shares remain lackluster, Jim Cramer is refusing to give up on AI chip giant NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA).

items.headline: Oil prices rise as U.S. launches new Iran airstrikes, while Trump abandons Strait of Hormuz fee
items.summary: Oil prices rose on Tuesday after U.S. President Donald Trump announced plans to impose shipping fees in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: Lucid dismisses report that it is weighing filing for bankruptcy or going private after shares plunge
items.summary: The report said Lucid was considering options that could include going private or filing for bankruptcy protection.

items.headline: Johnson & Johnson has a chance to show it's more than just a rotation winner
items.summary: The healthcare giant's second-quarter earnings will shine the spotlight on its exciting new products and pipeline.

items.headline: Supreme Court Justice Barrett says the threat level against judges 'is really high'
items.summary: Supreme Court Justices Amy Coney Barrett and Elena Kagan are testifying about the high court's budget request, which includes higher spending for security.

items.headline: Bipartisan group of senators propose Social Security reform process ahead of funding shortfall
items.summary: Social Security's trust fund that helps pay retirement benefits may run out in about six years. A bipartisan group of senators is calling for earlier reform.
